label: Oestradiol
biological_meaning: E2 present in the culture medium (published regimen: 10 nM).

label: Progestin
biological_meaning: Progesterone (hormone-only regimen) or MPA (published regimen: 1 uM) present.

label: cAMP analogue
biological_meaning: 8-Br-cAMP present (published regimen: 250 uM).

label: XAV939
biological_meaning: Tankyrase inhibitor present (published regimen: 10 uM). Read by no rule: which ADOC compartment it acts on, and through what, is not established (the prototype's U4b).

label: BMP receptor inhibitor
biological_meaning: BMP type I receptor inhibitor present (WP1 Task 1.4; compound to be selected).

label: Smoothened inhibitor
biological_meaning: Candidate perturbation, not in the funded protocol: a Smoothened antagonist that blocks Hedgehog reception. Gives the reception step a determinant of its own.

label: FOXO1 inhibitor
biological_meaning: Candidate perturbation, not in the funded protocol: FOXO1 activity inhibitor (AS1842856, used in human ESC by Ujvari 2017).

label: IL-1beta
biological_meaning: IL-1beta present (G2 inflammation model; dose not fixed).

label: Epithelial ERalpha activity
biological_meaning: Ligand-activated oestrogen receptor alpha signalling in epithelial cells.

label: Epithelial PGR activity
biological_meaning: Ligand-activated progesterone receptor signalling in epithelial cells.

label: Epithelial IHH expression
biological_meaning: Indian hedgehog expression in epithelial cells (not the secreted ligand pool).

label: Epithelial FGFR-ERK1/2 activity
biological_meaning: Epithelial FGF receptor signalling to ERK1/2 in response to the stromal paracrine mitogen.

label: Epithelial secretory differentiation
biological_meaning: Secretory differentiation programme of the epithelium.

label: Epithelial proliferation
biological_meaning: E2-driven epithelial proliferation.

label: IHH ligand
biological_meaning: Secreted IHH available to stromal cells across the ADOC membrane.

label: Paracrine mitogen ligand
biological_meaning: Secreted stromal mitogen (FGF family; FGF9 is the only one shown to respond in human ESC) available to the epithelium.

label: BMP2 ligand
biological_meaning: Secreted BMP2 available to stromal BMP receptors (autocrine and paracrine).

label: Secreted PAEP
biological_meaning: Glycodelin (PAEP) secreted into the outlet medium.

label: Secreted PRL
biological_meaning: Prolactin secreted into the basal outlet medium.

label: Secreted IGFBP-1
biological_meaning: IGFBP-1 secreted into the outlet medium (apical and basal outlets).

label: Stromal ERalpha activity
biological_meaning: Ligand-activated oestrogen receptor alpha signalling in stromal cells.

label: Stromal PGR activity
biological_meaning: Ligand-activated progesterone receptor signalling in stromal cells.

label: Stromal cAMP/PKA
biological_meaning: cAMP-dependent protein kinase signalling in stromal cells.

label: Stromal C/EBPbeta
biological_meaning: C/EBPbeta binding at decidual gene promoters, induced by cAMP.

label: Stromal FOXO1 activity
biological_meaning: Nuclear FOXO1 activity in stromal cells (cAMP-driven; progestin attenuation is partial and not encoded).

label: Stromal IRF4
biological_meaning: IRF4, a decidual transcription regulator whose PR binding site needs FOXO1.

label: Stromal Hedgehog reception
biological_meaning: PTCH1/SMO/GLI signalling in stromal cells in response to IHH.

label: Stromal COUP-TFII
biological_meaning: NR2F2 response downstream of Hedgehog reception and PGR.

label: Stromal BMP2 expression
biological_meaning: BMP2 ligand expression (not the secreted ligand, not pathway activity).

label: BMP receptor/SMAD1/5/8 activity
biological_meaning: BMP receptor signalling and SMAD1/5/8 phosphorylation.

label: Stromal WNT4
biological_meaning: WNT4 expression downstream of BMP/SMAD signalling.

label: Stromal HAND2
biological_meaning: HAND2 activity in stromal cells.

label: Stromal mitogen expression
biological_meaning: Expression of the stromal paracrine mitogen (FGF family): induced through stromal ERalpha, repressed by HAND2.

label: Stromal IL-1 receptor signalling
biological_meaning: IL-1 receptor (IL1R1) signalling in stromal cells.

label: Stromal JNK
biological_meaning: IL-1beta-activated c-Jun N-terminal kinase signalling.

label: Stromal ERK1/2
biological_meaning: IL-1beta-activated ERK1/2 signalling in stromal cells.

label: Stromal decidualization
biological_meaning: Decidual differentiation programme of the stroma.

label: Stromal IGFBP1 expression
biological_meaning: IGFBP1 transcription in decidualising stroma.

label: Stromal PRL expression
biological_meaning: PRL transcription in decidualising stroma.
